# mtncloud_node_type (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud node type data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_node_type" "example_node_type" {
  name = "TF Example node type"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the node type
- `name` (String) The name of the node type
